description: Office of the Governor Ura Province - Order to appoint Mrs. R. H. C. Priyanthi and Others to the Provincial Serrice
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple government personnel appointments (naming specific individuals like Mrs. R. H. C. Priyanthi, Engineer Mr. Chandrathilake, etc.) with their basic titles (Acting Director of Social Service, Director to the Road, etc.) but does NOT include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. The content focuses solely on who is being appointed to which positions, making it a People Gazette (Type 2).
